questions.text: Describe the pilot site and what you will measure.
questions.answer: Our pilot site is a 2-hectare pilot line. We run one pilot with a fish farm in Nazaré, Portugal, since March 2026. In 2026, we measured with the University of Example that the kelp on our 2-hectare pilot line took up an estimated 1.4 t of nitrogen.
